name: redact
description: Redacts secrets and PII from every row Claude Code stores, before the model reads it and before the transcript keeps it. Reach L0: no network, no processes, no files.

pii.title: Redact PII
pii.description: Also hide email addresses, phone numbers, payment cards, SSNs, Aadhaar, PAN and IBAN. Secrets are always hidden.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Hide the transcript line that reports what was redacted. /redact still shows the session total.

off.title: Rules off
off.description: Comma-separated rule ids to skip, for example generic-assignment,email. Ids are listed in RULES.md.
